name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas (TTF) near €100/MWh, up 36% in a month, as Qatari LNG stays blocked
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €100/MWh on 2 Nov, far above the €70 Alert line and up 36% over the month. Hormuz, the export route for Qatari LNG, remained largely shut on 2 Nov; Iran said it would not reopen the strait until the US ends its naval blockade, while talks in Doha continue.
for_you: Wholesale gas is feeding into energy bills; the Ofgem price cap sets what most UK households pay. Ofgem and gov.uk list help for those struggling with bills.
rubric_hit: TTF €100 > €70 Alert line; Qatari LNG route impeded

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures
ANI — Iran demands end to US naval blockade before any agreement on Strait of Hormuz

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
